fields.summary: Autonomous conductor run 01M7KHWS planned change set 01M76XT3 (Leaf contract) with no owner. Research: prompt-gap.md rec 7 and section 2.1 items 2-5 ask for per-leaf files and must-not, a failure case or a waiver in every acceptance, one-concern sizing, a no-failure-case plan-review kind, and mechanical checks moved from the reviewer to review-check; section 5 names Go model fields files and must-not, interim inside acceptance text. Code read: internal/op/fields.go refuses unknown fields on new writes (knownFieldsOnly in internal/api/write_node.go); run.Kinds in internal/run/journal.go holds seven kinds, uncovered-intent and oversized-leaf already landed with Plan role topics (01M76XRP), so this change set adds only no-failure-case (the scope note 01M76YY); review-check's plan-review path (runRunReviewCheck in internal/api/run_review.go) reads rounds only and checks no leaf field; brief.md (internal/run/brief.go, internal/api/run_brief.go) lists each leaf's statement and acceptance; landed acceptances already mark a failure case with the words (failure case); rhiza check already reports duplicate handles. Planner rulings, no owner asked: the contract is capability fields files, must_not and failure_waiver rather than acceptance text; review-check tests the fields and the words failure case at every round; no-failure-case is major and judges whether the failure case is real. This change set's own leaves carry files and must-not in their statement text, because the fields do not exist until its first leaf is built.
